dialogues.speaker: Fatui Task Force Rookie
dialogues.text: (Oi, it's your turn! What are you staring at?)

dialogues.speaker: Azalea
dialogues.text: Not bad! Your next task is to patrol in formation. And don't think you can slack off once you get out there — I'll be watching you like a hawk!

dialogues.speaker: Azalea
dialogues.text: Now, about turn! Stay in line!

dialogues.speaker: Azalea
dialogues.text: What are you playing at!? You can't even follow a basic order!? You! Yes, you, blondie! That's right, you! Where's your uniform!?

choices.text: I erm... I just got here. Where do I sign up?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Since when was this part of the plan?

response.speaker: Azalea
response.text: Oh, really? I wasn't expecting any new signees. But you've made it out here, I guess, so that shows some dedication.

response.speaker: Azalea
response.text: However, I'm sorry to say that infiltrators like you should think twice before trying to trick the eternally vigiliant Azalea!

choices.text: Uniform? I'm not really into dressing up...

response.speaker: Azalea
response.text: What!? Think you're funny, do you? I knew there was something off about you. Let's see if you fight as well as you joke!

dialogues.speaker: Azalea
dialogues.text: Someone not feeling in the mood to train today? ... You! Yes, you, blondie! You've clearly got a bit of an attitude about you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Me? I just want to praise our glorious cause!

dialogues.speaker: Azalea
dialogues.text: I'm not opposed to young people expressing themselves, but there's a time and a place. Our work here is too important to be overshadowed by explorations of individuality.

dialogues.speaker: Azalea
dialogues.text: Nevertheless, you remind me of myself when I was a fresh recruit. Keep training and don't you dare disappoint me!

dialogues.speaker: Azalea
dialogues.text: Right then, back to training, everyone! Prepare to head to your patrol stations — march in step!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: One, two, three, four! Fatui dogs can lick the floor!

dialogues.speaker: Azalea
dialogues.text: Hmph! Looks like we've got a smart-mouthed spy in our ranks. Not to worry, it just so happens I want to see the fruits of your training — everyone, get them!
